description:
Get the authenticated user's Tag Team session info.

    Tag Team is a daily paper-trading competition: you get $10k paper
    capital split 70% human / 30% Co-Pilot bot. Make manual trades,
    deploy the Co-Pilot after 3 closed manual trades, and your combined
    PnL is scored on the daily leaderboard.

    Returns session state, open positions, bot status, and rank.
name: tag_team_info
